origin: cwe/89/csharp Taint Sinks: SqlCommand.ExecuteScalar() with concatenated command text

finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command
finding.summary: The metric endpoint concatenates a request-controlled actor into SqlCommand.CommandText before ExecuteScalar() runs.

trap: Calling SqlCommand.Prepare() on the concatenated command, escaping quotes in actor, or adding a parameter without changing CommandText to use it. The query needs a typed parameter whose Value is assigned before ExecuteScalar().
must_preserve: The endpoint still returns a JSON object containing count, and actor values with apostrophes are counted as literal actor names rather than rejected or changing the SQL predicate.
